carbon-black.$description: Carbon Black — Primary text, hairlines, filled primary buttons, dark section backgrounds, and card surfaces on dark bands — the structural default that carries the entire system

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Page canvas, card surfaces, button text on dark fills, form input fills — the negative space that frames everything

warm-gray.$description: Warm Gray — Body text on light surfaces, subtle borders, muted helper text — a near-gray that warms the neutral palette slightly

mist.$description: Mist — Hairline dividers, input borders, disabled states — the lightest structural line in the system

fog.$description: Fog — Placeholder text, inactive borders, secondary dividers

slate.$description: Slate — Inactive nav text, subtle metadata

iris-shadow.$description: Iris Shadow — Rare shadow tint and muted border accent

neon-pulse.$description: Neon Pulse — Brand accent — logo mark, active nav underline, highlighted section labels, badge borders, decorative emphasis on key words — one vivid pink against the monochrome system

helvetica-neue.$description: Single-family system used for everything from 12px captions to 200px stat numerals. The extreme range (16× scale) is the signature — the same weight carries caption text and hero headlines, letting scale and tracking do the differentiation. Positive letter-spacing (+0.08em) on the smallest sizes signals uppercase labels; aggressive negative tracking (-0.05em) on display sizes tightens large type to a poster-like density.
